Activity: Shows who changed what and when.
ActivityItem: An entry in an activity log.
ActivityItem.icon: Icon. When empty, shows the person's avatar
Board: A work board with draggable cards and per-column work limits.
Board.label: Accessible name
Board.cardMove: A card moved. Its column has already been updated
BoardCard: A work card on a board.
BoardCard.title: Title
BoardColumn: A column on a work board.
BoardColumn.title: Title
Button: A button that can open a menu.
Button.kind: primary, accent, neutral, ghost or danger
Button.label: Accessible name and tooltip for an icon-only button
Button.loading: Whether an operation is in progress
Button.enabled: Whether the button can be used
Button.wide: Whether the button fills its container
Check.enabled: Whether the box can be used
Column: A column in a DataGrid or TreeGrid.
Column.label: Header
Column.path: Field path relative to the row context
Column.type: text, link, number, currency, date, status, progress, person or spark
Column.grow: Share of the available extra width
Column.unitPath: Path to the unit or currency field
Column.statePath: Path to a status field with success, wait, danger, info or none
Column.states: Mapping from cell values to statuses
Column.sortable: Whether the column can be sorted
Column.pinned: Whether this leading column stays in place during horizontal scrolling
Column.formatter: Function that formats a value and row context as text
Command: An entry in the command palette.
CommandPalette: A searchable palette that goes in the view's dependents and can open with Ctrl+K or Command+K.
CommandPalette.hotkey: Whether to listen for Ctrl+K or Command+K
CommandPalette.isOpen: Returns whether the palette is open
CommandPalette.open: Opens the palette and focuses search
Confirm: Asks for confirmation in a modal dialog.
Confirm.ask: Resolves to true when the user confirms, or false when they cancel or dismiss
DataGrid: A virtualized grid with keyboard navigation, range totals, inline editing and spreadsheet clipboard support.
DataGrid.selectionMode: Row selection mode, None or Multi
DataGrid.summary: Whether to show the summary bar
DataGrid.noData: Message shown when there are no rows
DataGrid.label: Accessible name
DataGrid.rows: Rows supplied by a list binding without a template
DataGrid.rowPress: A row was opened via a link cell or Enter
DataGrid.cellChange: A cell changed. The value has already been written to the model
DataGrid.stateChange: Column order, width or sorting changed
DataGrid.getState: Returns column order, hidden columns, widths and sort order for saving
DataGrid.setState: Restores saved state and skips unknown columns
DataGrid.openSettings: Opens column settings next to the supplied opener
DataGrid.getSelectedContexts: Returns selected row contexts in selection order
DateField: A date input with a calendar and typed shortcuts.
DateField.value: Date as yyyy-MM-dd or a Date object
DateField.label: Field label
DateField.marks: Map from dates to notes displayed in the calendar
DateField.enabled: Whether the field can be used
DateRangeField: An inclusive date range with a two-month calendar and presets.
DateRangeField.start: Start as yyyy-MM-dd or a Date object
DateRangeField.label: Field label
DateRangeField.marks: Map from dates to notes displayed in the calendar
DateRangeField.enabled: Whether the field can be used
Dialog: A modal dialog placed in the view's dependents.
Dialog.title: Title
Dialog.subtitle: Subtitle
Dialog.dismissable: Whether Esc and the close button can dismiss the dialog
Dialog.danger: Whether the dialog concerns a hard-to-reverse action
Dialog.close: The user dismissed the dialog. Call preventDefault to keep it open
Dialog.setOpen: Opens or closes the modal dialog
Empty: Explains why a region has no content and can offer a next step.
Empty.title: Heading
Empty.actions: Actions the user can take next
FileDrop: Selects files and shows their status. The application handles upload.
FileDrop.label: Field label
FileDrop.accept: Accepted types or extensions, for example .pdf,image/*
FileDrop.maxSize: Maximum size in MB. Zero means unlimited
FileDrop.multiple: Whether multiple files can be selected
FileDrop.remove: The user requested removal of a file
FileDrop.retry: The user requested a retry of a failed upload
FileItem: A file entry with upload status.
FileItem.name: Filename
FilterBar: Turns typed criteria into UI5 filters.
FilterBar.change: Filters changed. Pass filters directly to ListBinding.filter
FilterBar.getFilters: Returns active filters, OR within a field and AND across fields
FilterField: A field available in a FilterBar.
FilterField.label: Field label
FilterField.unit: Unit displayed with a numeric value
Flow: Shows quantities moving between steps in a process.
Flow.label: Accessible name
Flow.select: A step was selected. An empty key clears selection
FlowLink: A quantity flowing between two process steps.
FlowNode: A step in a process flow.
FlowNode.label: Label
Form: Groups fields into labeled sections and validates required values.
Form.stacked: Whether section titles sit above the fields
Form.getFields: Returns the fields in the form
Form.validate: Marks empty required fields, focuses the first invalid field and returns whether every required field is filled
FormSection: A labeled group of fields in a form.
FormSection.title: Section title
FormSection.content: Fields and other controls in the section
HoldButton: Confirms a deliberate action after a hold, with a two-press alternative.
HoldButton.done: Whether the action has been confirmed
HoldButton.enabled: Whether the button can be used
Icon: A line icon using a Kor name or a UI5 icon URI.
Icon.name: Kor icon name or sap-icon:// URI
Icon.alt: Accessible description. Leave empty for decorative icons
Flag: A flag of a country, region or organization. Covers every ISO 3166-1 country (249), UK nations ("gb-sct"), some regions ("es-ct") and organizations ("eu", "un"). The flag loads only when visible and its name is read in the app language.
Flag.code: Flag code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ("TR"), subdivision ("gb-sct") or organization ("eu"). An unknown code shows an empty flag
Flag.alt: Accessible description. When empty, the country name
Flag.decorative: Decorative: screen readers skip the flag when the country name is written next to it
Flag.getKnownCode: Code of the shown flag. Empty when unknown
LookupField: Finds one or more records through suggestions or a searchable lookup dialog.
LookupField.value: Key of the selected record in single-selection mode
LookupField.text: Display text of the selected record in single-selection mode
LookupField.selection: Array of selected records as {key, text} in multiple-selection mode
LookupField.multiple: Whether multiple records can be chosen
LookupField.textPath: Path to a record's display text
LookupField.infoPath: Path to secondary text in suggestions
LookupField.label: Field label and dialog title
LookupField.enabled: Whether the field can be used
LookupField.columns: Dialog columns. Defaults to key and text
LookupField.rows: Records supplied by a list binding without a template
LookupField.getSelectedKeys: Returns selected keys in multiple-selection mode for form validation
MenuItem: An entry in a button's menu.
MenuItem.danger: Whether the action is hard to reverse
Message: A message displayed within the page.
Message.state: success, wait, danger, info, none or a UI5 message type
Message.title: Heading
Message.closable: Whether the user can dismiss the message
MessageItem: An entry in a message list.
MessageItem.title: Heading
MessageList: Lists messages by severity, with filters and navigation to affected fields.
MessageList.press: A message was pressed. Its target, if available, has received focus
MultiSelect: A searchable field for choosing several options.
MultiSelect.label: Field label
MultiSelect.enabled: Whether the field can be used
NavItem: A navigation entry in the application shell.
NavItem.count: Count shown at the trailing edge
NumberField: A locale-aware numeric input with stepping controls.
NumberField.label: Field label
NumberField.enabled: Whether the field can be used
Person: An avatar with initials and a color derived from the name.
Person.name: Person's name
Person.role: Role. Providing it also displays the name
Popover: A small overlay anchored to another control or an HTML element.
Popover.title: Title
Popover.openBy: Opens the popover beside the supplied control or element
Popover.isOpen: Returns whether the popover is open
RadioGroup: A single-choice group shown as rows or cards.
RadioGroup.label: Group label
RadioGroup.cards: Whether to show options as cards
RadioGroup.enabled: Whether the group can be used
RadioItem: An option in a radio group.
Schedule: A resource schedule with movable and resizable tasks and visible conflicts.
Schedule.start: First displayed day as a Date or yyyy-MM-dd
Schedule.today: Reference date for today. Defaults to the system date
Schedule.dayWidth: Width of one day in pixels
Schedule.label: Accessible name
Schedule.taskChange: A task changed. Its start, end and lane have already been updated
ScheduleLane: A resource lane on the schedule.
ScheduleLane.title: Title
ScheduleTask: A task placed on a resource schedule.
ScheduleTask.title: Title
ScheduleTask.start: Start as a Date or yyyy-MM-dd
ScheduleTask.state: success, wait, danger, info or none
Segmented: A compact single-choice control with a sliding indicator.
Segmented.label: Accessible name
Segmented.setSelectedKey: Sets the selected key and updates the indicator
SelectField: A searchable field for choosing one option.
SelectField.label: Field label
SelectField.enabled: Whether the field can be used
Series: A series of a Trend or BarChart.
Series.name: Series name
Series.kind: For Trend: area, line, bar or ghost
Sheet: A nonmodal side panel for record details.
Sheet.title: Title
Sheet.subtitle: Subtitle
Shell: An application frame with navigation, a top bar and a content area.
Shell.title: Top bar title
Shell.selectedKey: Key of the selected navigation entry
Shell.collapsed: Whether navigation is reduced to icons
Skeleton: Shows loading placeholders until content is ready.
Stack: A row, column or responsive grid layout.
Stack.row: Whether to lay items out side by side
Stage.title: Step title
Stage.state: success, wait, danger, info or none
Stages: Shows the stages of a record in order.
Stat: Displays a metric with an optional change and sparkline.
Stat.label: Metric label
Stat.delta: Percentage change. Zero hides the change
Stat.hero: Whether to use the larger presentation
Status: Combines color, shape and text to convey status.
Status.text: Status text. Defaults to the name of the state
Status.state: success, wait, danger, info or none
Tab: A tab and its associated content.
Tabs: Switches between panels and renders the currently selected panel.
Tabs.selectedKey: Key of the selected tab. Empty selects the first tab
Tabs.label: Accessible name
Text: Renders text in one of five typography styles.
Text.kind: display, title, heading, body or muted
TextField: A single-line or multiline input with its own label and validation text.
TextField.label: Field label
TextField.error: Validation message. A nonempty message marks the field invalid
TextField.type: text, email, tel, url, search, password or date
TextField.rows: Number of rows. More than one creates a multiline field
TextField.enabled: Whether the field can be used
TextField.change: The value changed when the user left the field
Theme: Sets runtime appearance for the page.
Theme.get: Returns a copy of the current theme settings
Theme.isDark: Returns whether dark mode is active, including the system preference
Theme.set: Updates the supplied theme settings and applies them to the page
Toast: Shows a short notification with an optional action.
Toast.show: Shows a notification and can attach an action button
Toggle.enabled: Whether the switch can be used
Tooltip: Shows supporting text when its host is hovered or focused.
TreeGrid: Displays a tree binding in a DataGrid with expandable branches.
TreeGrid.toggle: A branch opened or closed and may load children
TreeGrid.toggle(): Opens or closes a branch at a visible row index
TreeGrid.expandToLevel: Expands branches to the given level. Zero closes all branches
TreeGrid.getState: Returns column state and the paths of open branches
TreeGrid.setState: Restores column state and open branches
Trend: Displays time series as areas, lines, bars or shaded targets.
Trend.label: Accessible name
Variants: Saves and restores named views of connected controls.
Variants.storageKey: Browser storage key. Empty disables browser storage
Variants.shareable: Whether to offer the share option
Variants.title: Whether to use heading typography
Variants.targets: Controls whose state is saved and restored
Variants.change: Saved views changed through creation, removal, rename or default selection
Variants.apply: Applies the view with the supplied key
Variants.saveAs: Saves the current state under a new name
Variants.save: Overwrites the selected view with the current state
Link: A text link. Behaves as a button when `href` is empty.
Link.href: Address. Only http, https, mailto, tel and relative addresses are opened
Link.target: Use _blank to open a new tab
Link.press: The link was pressed. preventDefault stops navigation
Breadcrumbs: A breadcrumb trail. Middle steps move into a menu when space is short.
Breadcrumbs.label: Accessible name
Breadcrumbs.items: Steps. The last one is the current location
Breadcrumbs.select: A step was chosen. preventDefault stops navigation
Crumb.href: Address. When empty, only the select event fires
Accordion.multiple: Whether several sections can be open at once
Accordion.toggle: A section was opened or closed
AccordionItem.title: Title
Card: A card with a title, status and actions. The whole card is pressable when `press` is attached.
Card.title: Title
Details.columns: Maximum columns. Fewer are used when space is short
Details.inline: Whether the label sits beside the value
Detail.label: Label
Detail.copyable: Whether to show a copy button
Detail.wide: Whether the field spans the whole row
Detail.content: A control shown instead of the value
Progress.label: Label
Progress.text: Value text. Defaults to the percentage
Progress.state: success, wait, danger, info or none
Rating.label: Label
Rating.readOnly: Whether the rating is display only. Fractions are drawn
Slider: A slider. Selects an interval when `range` is set.
Slider.value: Value, or the start of the interval
Slider.label: Label
List: A list of people, documents or records with optional single or multiple selection.
List.label: Accessible name
List.divided: Whether to separate rows with lines
ListItem.title: Title
ListItem.meta: Value at the end of the row
ListItem.person: Person name. Shows an avatar instead of the icon
ListItem.group: Group heading. Rows of a group must be adjacent
TimeField: A time field. Choose from a list or type "9", "930", "2:30 pm", "now" or "+30".
TimeField.value: Time as HH:mm, HH:mm:ss or OData V2 Edm.Time
TimeField.label: Label
TimeField.step: Interval in the list, in minutes
DateTimeField: A date and time field. Shows local time.
DateTimeField.value: Value as a Date or an ISO 8601 string
DateTimeField.label: Label
DateTimeField.step: Interval in the time list, in minutes
DateTimeField.defaultTime: Time used when only a day is chosen, HH:mm
TreeField: A field that picks from a tree. Typing filters the branches.
TreeField.label: Label
TreeField.leafOnly: Whether only leaves can be chosen
TreeField.showPath: Whether the field shows the parent branches
TreeField.items: A flat list. The tree is built from `parentKey`
PromptField: An AI prompt box with suggestions, send and stop. The application produces the answer.
PromptField.label: Accessible name
PromptField.working: Whether an answer is being produced. Shows stop instead of send
PromptField.note: Note below the box, such as an accuracy warning
PromptField.clearOnSubmit: Whether the box is cleared after sending
PromptField.suggestions: Ready prompts, shown while the box is empty
Wizard: Step by step input. Forms in the step are validated before moving on.
Wizard.stepChange: The step is changing. preventDefault stops it
Wizard.cancel: Cancelled. The button is hidden when not attached
Wizard.validate: Validates the forms in the current step.
Wizard.goTo: Moves to a step. Validates the current step when moving forward.
WizardStep.title: Title
WizardStep.valid: Application check. False blocks moving on
Splitter: Two panes with an adjustable divider.
Splitter.label: Accessible name of the divider
ColumnLayout: A list, a record and its detail side by side. Only the deepest column shows when space is short.
ColumnLayout.full: Whether the last column takes all the space
ColumnLayout.navigation: Whether to show back, expand and close buttons
ColumnLayout.close: The last column is closing. preventDefault stops it
RecordPage: A record page with a title, summary, actions and a section bar that follows scrolling.
RecordPage.title: Title
RecordPage.subtitle: Subtitle
RecordPage.height: Height. The page scrolls inside itself
RecordPage.scrollToSection: Scrolls to the section with the given key.
RecordSection.title: Title
Inbox: A notification center with an unread count, a filter and row actions.
Inbox.title: Title
Inbox.unreadOnly: Whether to show unread items only
Inbox.press: A notification was opened and marked as read
Inbox.dismiss: Removal was requested. The application deletes the row
InboxItem.title: Title
InboxItem.person: Sender. Shows an avatar instead of the icon
MonthCalendar: Shows events in a month view. When space is short, the day's events are listed below.
MonthCalendar.label: Accessible name
CalendarEvent.title: Title
CalendarEvent.start: First day as a Date or yyyy-MM-dd
CalendarEvent.end: Last day. Defaults to a single day
Compare: Compares offers, versions or records side by side and marks differences.
Compare.onlyDifferences: Whether to show only rows that differ
Compare.toggle: Whether to show the differences switch
Compare.label: Accessible name
Compare.baseline: Index of the baseline column. Use -1 for none
Compare.differs: Whether the values of a row differ.
CompareColumn.title: Title
CompareRow.label: Field name
CompareRow.best: Use min or max to mark the best number
Heatmap: Shows intensity at row and column intersections with color and numbers.
Heatmap.label: Accessible name
Heatmap.rowOrder: Row order. Defaults to data order
Heatmap.columnOrder: Column order. Defaults to data order
Waterfall: Shows the increases and decreases from a start to a result.
Waterfall.label: Accessible name
Waterfall.getRanges: Where each step starts and ends.
WaterfallStep.label: Name
WaterfallStep.value: Amount of change. Calculated for totals when empty
PieChart: Shows the parts of a whole as a pie or donut.
PieChart.label: Accessible name
PieChart.totalLabel: Name in the center of the donut. Defaults to "Total"
PieChart.maxSlices: Maximum slices (2-6). The rest is added up in "Other"
PieChart.slicePress: A slice was pressed. For "Other" key is empty and keys lists its slices
PieChart.getParts: Drawn slices and their shares. tone 0 is the "Other" slice.
PieSlice: A slice of a pie chart.
PieSlice.label: Name
PieSlice.value: Value. Zero and negative values draw no slice but appear in the list
BarChart: Compares categories with vertical or horizontal bars: grouped, stacked or percent. Read it with the mouse or arrow keys.
BarChart.label: Accessible name
BarChart.height: Height in pixels. 0 means 260 for vertical bars and one row per category for horizontal bars
BarChart.showValues: Writes values at bar ends; totals when stacked. Values that do not fit are left out
BarChart.series: Series (up to 6). Series.kind is not used
BarChart.barPress: A bar was pressed. seriesIndex is -1 from the keyboard or between bars
BarChart.getBars: Where each bar of a category starts and ends. Stacks add positives and negatives separately.
Pivot: A pivot table that aggregates by row and column fields with expandable branches. Data is processed in the browser.
Pivot.aggregate: sum, count, avg, min or max
Pivot.label: Accessible name
Pivot.expandedLevels: Levels visible at first. 1 shows only the first level
Pivot.cellPress: A cell was pressed. Provides field and value pairs
Shipment: The journey of a shipment. The vehicle moves between stops and becomes a truck, ship, plane, train, van or courier bike for each leg.
Shipment.title: Tracking number or title
Shipment.mode: truck, van, bike, train, ship or plane
Shipment.status: transit, waiting, problem, returning or delivered
Shipment.progress: Percentage of the route. Negative derives it from the stops
Shipment.scene: Whether to draw the road scene
Shipment.getPosition: Position of the vehicle on the route, 0 to 1.
Shipment.getLegMode: Transport mode of the current leg.
ShipmentStop.title: Place or step
ShipmentStop.icon: Icon. Defaults to the status icon
ShipmentStop.state: success passed, info on the way, wait held, danger problem, none upcoming
ShipmentStop.mode: Transport mode of the leg leaving this stop
DeliveryRoute: A delivery round. The van visits stops in order and shows remaining parcels and delays.
DeliveryRoute.title: Round name or license plate
DeliveryStop.title: Recipient
DeliveryStop.state: success delivered, danger failed, wait late, none upcoming
LoadPlan: A vehicle loading plan with pallet positions, weight and space use. Overloads are marked.
LoadPlan.title: Vehicle or license plate
LoadItem.title: Name
LoadItem.state: Status. danger and wait are outlined
DockBoard: A dock board with docked trucks, progress and the waiting queue. Choose a queued truck, then a free dock, to assign it.
DockBoard.title: Title
DockBoard.assign: A truck was assigned to a dock. The application updates the data
Dock.name: Dock name
Dock.plate: License plate of the docked truck. Empty means free
Dock.state: loading, unloading, waiting, problem or closed
DockTruck: A truck waiting for a dock.
ProductionLine: A production line. Stations use process icons for the industry, products move on the belt and the bottleneck is marked.
ProductionLine.title: Line name
ProductionLine.sector: textile, automotive, food, beverage, pharma, electronics, furniture, metal, packaging, chemical, construction or energy
ProductionLine.productIcon: Icon of the product on the belt. Defaults to the sector
ProductionLine.showBottleneck: Whether to mark the slowest running station
ProductionLine.getBottleneck: The slowest running station. None when all rates match.
ProductionStation.title: Name
ProductionStation.process: Process, such as weaving, dyeing, cutting, sewing, pressing, welding, painting, assembly, robot, baking, smt, inspection or packing
ProductionStation.state: info running, success done, wait waiting, danger stopped, none idle
MachineCard: A machine card with OEE (availability, performance, quality) and a downtime strip for the shift.
MachineCard.title: Machine
MachineCard.from: Text at the start of the strip
MachineCard.until: Text at the end of the strip
MachineCard.spans: Time spans of the shift in order
MachineCard.getOee: OEE percentage, the product of the three rates.
MachineSpan.state: info running, wait setup, danger failure, none planned stop
BankCard: A bank card showing only the last four digits, limit use and freezing.
BankCard.last4: Last four digits. Anything more is not shown
BankCard.canFreeze: Whether to show the freeze button
BankCard.freeze: Freezing is changing. preventDefault stops it
BankLogo: A bank logo. The logo comes from src, then the registerBankLogos registry, then the setBankLogoProvider server. Without any, or if the image fails to load, a mark made from the BIC or name and the country flag is shown for any bank in the world. Kor does not ship bank logos.
BankLogo.name: Bank name. Used for the accessible label and the initials
BankLogo.bic: SWIFT/BIC code (8 or 11 characters). Used as the registry key and for the country flag
BankLogo.iban: IBAN. Read only for the country flag when there is no BIC. Never written to the page
BankLogo.key: Your own bank key, such as "TR-00062". The registry looks it up first
BankLogo.src: Logo URL. When set, the registry is not used
BankLogo.showFlag: Show the country flag in the corner
BankLogo.getResolved: The logo to draw. Empty src means the generated mark
Statement: Account transactions grouped by day with money in, money out and a filter.
Statement.label: Accessible name
Statement.balance: Current balance. When set, each day's closing balance is shown
Transaction.title: Counterparty
Transaction.category: market, fuel, food, travel, salary, transfer, bill, phone, health, education, rent, cash, saving, fee or store
Transaction.person: Person. Shows an avatar instead of the icon
Transaction.state: Status. danger means cancelled and is left out of totals
Installments: An installment or loan plan with principal, interest, paid amounts and the next payment.
Installments.label: Accessible name
Installment.state: success paid, danger overdue, wait pending, none upcoming
Timetable: A weekly timetable. Overlapping lessons are drawn side by side.
Timetable.label: Accessible name
Timetable.days: Number of days from the start of the week
Timetable.firstDay: First day. 1 is Monday, 0 is Sunday
Timetable.hourHeight: Height of an hour in pixels
Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.tone: Color 1 to 6. 0 derives it from the title
Classroom: A classroom seating plan with attendance. Press a student to cycle present, late and absent.
Classroom.title: Class
Student.name: Name
CoursePath: A learning path. Modules unlock in order along a winding route.
CoursePath.title: Course
CourseModule.title: Name
CourseModule.kind: video, quiz, exam, lab, reading or live
OrgChart: An organization chart with expandable branches, open positions and team sizes.
OrgChart.label: Accessible name
OrgChart.people: A flat list. The chart is built from `managerKey`
OrgPerson: A person or position in the chart.
OrgPerson.name: Name
LeaveBalance: A leave balance showing used, planned, pending and remaining days one by one.
LeaveBalance.title: Leave type
ShiftRoster: A shift roster of people and days. Press a cell to change the shift. Understaffed days are marked.
ShiftRoster.label: Accessible name
ShiftRoster.start: First day as a Date or yyyy-MM-dd
ShiftRoster.change: A cell changed. An empty shift means off. The application updates the data
ShiftType.title: Name
ShiftType.icon: Icon, such as sun, sunset, moon or house
ShiftType.need: People needed. Zero is not checked
TalentGrid: A nine box talent grid of people by performance and potential.
TalentGrid.label: Accessible name
TalentGrid.titles: Names of the nine boxes, row by row from the top left
TalentGrid.move: Moved with Ctrl and an arrow key
TalentPerson.name: Name
